g.text: George B. Moody PhysioNet Challenge 2026 Submission
Cognitive Impairment Prediction from Polysomnography, Hemodynamics & Conformal Uncertainty Bounds
Discrete Wavelet Transform (db4 filter) + Signal Quality Index (SQI >= 0.60)
• CAISR Architecture: N3 SWS %, WASO, AHI, OAI, CAI, HI
• EEG Slow-Wave Activity SWA Power Ratio (Delta 0.5-4Hz / Alpha 8-12Hz)
• Hemodynamics: Shock Index, MAP, Rate Pressure Product, Vagal RMSSD
• 30% Deterministic AASM Expert Rule Safeguard Blend
• Distribution-free prediction intervals [p - q_hat, p + q_hat]
1. Glymphatic SWS Coupling: Direct correlation of EEG delta power with WASO fragmentation.
2. Zero Target Leakage: Injects stochastic physiological noise during cross-validation.
3. Zero-Dependency Meta-Model: Lightweight NumPy SGD meta-learner exporting pure JSON.
4. Contactless Ambient Sensor Fusion: Bedroom lux, temp, CO2 & wearable telemetry.
